description: Codex, design review of the Python versions (round 1), on every version: an f-string is not a docstring (a JoinedStr, not a str constant) and its interpolations run. `f"{1 / 0}"` raises before `self.skipTest("pending")`: the skip is not the first statement of the test (F2), a WARN, never a FAIL. The real runner reports an error, no skip. saidvsdid 0.1.0 read the f-string as a docstring and gave a FAIL.
